BILL000001.title: Emergency Communications Access Bill
BILL000001.summary: Allows temporary access before a warrant in narrowly defined emergencies.

BILL000002.title: Public Retail Banking Bill
BILL000002.summary: Creates a postal banking lender competing on basic credit and deposit products.

BILL000003.title: Community Policing Standards Bill
BILL000003.summary: Sets national community policing standards without dedicated funding.

BILL000004.title: National Infrastructure Bank Bill
BILL000004.summary: Creates a public bank for long-term transport, water and energy loans.

BILL000005.title: Injury Safeguards Bill
BILL000005.summary: Allows temporary duties only after a published injury finding and with a two-year sunset.

BILL000006.title: National Medicines Purchasing Bill
BILL000006.summary: Creates one public purchaser for covered prescription medicines.

BILL000007.title: Downturn Employment Security Bill
BILL000007.summary: Provides up to forty weeks when provincial unemployment exceeds a published threshold.

BILL000008.title: Public University Access Bill
BILL000008.summary: Funds a tuition-free first undergraduate degree at public universities.

BILL000009.title: Large Estates Contribution Bill
BILL000009.summary: Adds higher bands for the largest estates and closes trust-avoidance rules.

BILL000010.title: Medicines Market Bill
BILL000010.summary: Ends national price negotiation and permits insurers to set separate formularies.

BILL000011.title: Accelerated Carbon Pricing Bill
BILL000011.summary: Sets a ninety-five currency unit levy with industry transition grants.

BILL000012.title: Provincial List Elections Bill
BILL000012.summary: Replaces constituency STV with closed provincial party lists.

BILL000013.title: Water Self-Monitoring Bill
BILL000013.summary: Requires major dischargers to publish self-monitoring with random national audits.

BILL000014.title: Universal School Meals Bill
BILL000014.summary: Funds a meal for every pupil in participating public schools.

BILL000015.title: Zero-Carbon Grid Bill
BILL000015.summary: Requires a zero-carbon electricity supply for the interconnected grid by a fixed statutory year.

BILL000016.title: Nuclear Refurbishment Bill
BILL000016.summary: Authorizes refurbishment of existing reactors to extend licensed operating lives.
